2607.14541.title: Are LLM-Generated GPU Kernels Production-Ready? A Trace-Driven Benchmark and Optimization Agent
2607.14541.paper_summary: Existing GPU kernel generation benchmarks draw problems from synthetic or curated sources that diverge from deployed workloads. We present Atrex-Bench, a benchmark whose 30 operators and 440 shapes are sampled directly from full-cluster production inference traces of compute-limited, memory-rich GPUs. Each problem carries an importance weight derived from its share of observed GPU time, weighted by application card-hours and computed separately for the serving phases in which it runs, together with a per-problem roofline ceiling, so the aggregate score emphasizes the kernels that consume the most serving time. Evaluating six frontier coding agents on Atrex-Bench shows that even the best vanilla model reaches only ${\sim}10\%$ of the hardware roofline on production operators; and correctness alone overstates capability, since much of the apparent pass rate comes from PyTorch fallbacks rather than kernels the model wrote. To close this gap, we co-release Atrex-Kernel-Agent (AKA), a profile-driven kernel-optimization agent that combines iterative measure-revise search, optimization dropout for escaping stalled search contexts, and a layered GPU-optimization knowledge base (298 reference-kernel files and 244 optimization-knowledge documents, plus external upstream reference projects for API/ISA lookup). In a controlled case study, the agent converts zero-FlyDSL fallbacks into real kernels that match or exceed hand-tuned production baselines.
2607.14541.paper_summary_zh: 現有的 GPU 核心生成基準測試從合成或策劃的來源中提取問題，這些來源與實際部署的工作負載有所不同。<lb/>我們提出了 Atrex-Bench，這是一個基準測試，其 30 個運算子和 440 種形狀直接從計算受限、內存豐富的 GPU 的全集群生產推理痕跡中抽樣而來。<lb/>每個問題都帶有一個重要性權重，該權重源自其觀察到的 GPU 時間的份額，按應用卡小時加權，並分別計算在其運行的服務階段中，還有每個問題的屋頂線上限，因此總分強調那些消耗最多服務時間的核心。<lb/>在 Atrex-Bench 上評估六個前沿編碼代理顯示，即使是最好的原生模型在生產運算子上也僅達到約 10% 的硬件屋頂線；而僅僅正確性則高估了能力，因為許多表面上的通過率來自 PyTorch 的回退，而非模型所編寫的核心。<lb/>為了縮小這一差距，我們共同發布了 Atrex-Kernel-Agent (AKA)，這是一個基於配置文件的核心優化代理，結合了迭代測量-修訂搜索、優化放棄以逃避停滯的搜索上下文，以及一個分層的 GPU 優化知識庫（298 個參考核心文件和 244 個優化知識文檔，加上 API/ISA 查找的外部上游參考項目）。<lb/>在一個受控案例研究中，該代理將零 FlyDSL 回退轉換為實際核心，這些核心與手動調整的生產基準相匹配或超過。
